widgetData.source_sentence: Mind over matter: A dreamer learns to bend reality for personal gain.
sentences: A former bounty hunter takes up arms again to hunt down the outlaw responsible for the death of her daughter.
A woman becomes obsessed with finding proof of her husband's infidelity, leading her on a dark quest through haunted landscapes.
A dreamer becomes convinced that reality bends to his will, leading him on a quest to understand how he can control the fabric of our waking existence, at any cost.

widgetData.source_sentence: Two lonely souls meet at a wild nightclub; soon, they're changed forever by chance encounters.
sentences: A team searches for the last remnants of a lost colony on Mars before humanity can fully commit to colonization.
A journalist uncovers secrets behind the veil of clean cuts in the fashion industry.
Two strangers cross paths in a chaotic club during a night of partying and chaos – neither wants the other’s company, yet together, their lives begin to change in surprising ways.

widgetData.source_sentence: Survivor on isolated island listens to eerie ocean whispers for survival clues.
sentences: On a deserted island, a survivor listens to the ocean whispering its fears and desires, trying to decipher how to survive.
An archaeologist uncovers an ancient artifact that reveals secrets about his lost love, but must navigate forbidden knowledge and supernatural forces.
During a beach vacation in Greece, a trio of tourists discover an ancient artifact that unleashes a deadly underwater force.

widgetData.source_sentence: Jazz club owner fights for survival while reconnecting with his love amidst war-torn NYC.
sentences: With the Earth at risk of extinction due to technology gone awry, a man uses his last strength to protect his daughter.
As two sisters navigate their parents' inheritance dispute over an estate they love, they uncover secrets hidden beneath a family feud.
As a jazz club owner struggles to stay open in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by war, a passionate saxophonist reconnects with a love interest he couldn't save.

widgetData.source_sentence: Boy discovers treasure map in attic, embarks on grand adventure to find lost kingdoms.
sentences: A boy finds an ancient map to a legendary kingdom hidden in his grandfather's attic, leading him on a quest to reunite lost treasures.
After uncovering a secret society of vampires, young Jake must battle supernatural forces while rescuing his dying mother.
Private investigator Leo Stone faces corruption within his own agency when a high-profile murder case spirals out of control.
